edition: The Seasons Op.37a, Schirmer Library vol.909, edited/fingered by Louis Oesterle, New York G.Schirmer, 1909, plate 21360
scan_copy: NYPL/Internet Archive scan of the 1909 edition; title also bears a 1937 renewal-assignment notice. No source scan is redistributed.
scope: mm.1-16, opening section through its D-minor arrival; original continues at m17
basis: US public domain: underlying 1909 published notation is beyond its maximum 95-year copyright term. The 1937 renewal notice does not create a new term for that 1909 content.
scope_limit: US publication basis documented; this is not a worldwide legal certification or permission for unrelated editions.
transcription_method: Fresh explicit note/rhythm/voice table after visual reading of this Schirmer page. A prior 1948-based event listing was viewed only as a comparison aid; no old L2 or old MusicXML is loaded by the new builder. Schirmer is the notation authority.
transcription_boundary: Source pitches/rhythms/ties, 5 graces, 4 roll symbols and main phrasing/dynamics audited by agent. Fingering and pedal excluded; some slur/direction attachment positions are interpretive. Critical-edition certification and human source review NOT_RUN.
project_contributions: Project transcription/editing/arrangement/rendering contributions use the root MIT license where copyright applies; the historical public-domain material remains public domain. This does not license other input scores.
font_basis: SIL Open Font License 1.1; PDFs embed these fonts, no standalone font binaries are distributed. Full upstream notices retained in licenses/.
